title: Portfolio Mortgages UK
summary: Silver Oak Capital's portfolio mortgage page (search-result title 'Portfolio Mortgages UK', listed in site navigation under Residential / Wealth as 'Portfolio Mortgages') presents a portfolio mortgage as a facility that lets a landlord consolidate multiple investment properties under a single loan, secured against the aggregate value of the entire portfolio. It is open to individuals and limited companies (SPVs); any landlord with more than one property can apply, but the page says the true benefits are usually realised with four or more properties. A related FAQ passage says a property sold from the portfolio can often be replaced with a new purchase without redeeming the loan, provided value and rental income still cover the debt, and that Silver Oak can negotiate such substitution terms upfront. A related case study ('Residential Portfolio Refinance') describes a GBP 5.3m refinance of 10 London flats at 70% LTV, 2.50% five-year fixed, interest-only, structured as ten separate mortgages at the client's request rather than one portfolio facility. Firm-wide claims seen alongside: network of over 800 lenders, focus on loans over GBP 500,000. No rates, fees, LTV caps, timescales, process steps, H1 or meta description specific to this page were surfaced; search (c) returned nothing relevant.
